title: Veckans brott: Palmemordet och Christer Pettersson
original_title: Veckans brott: Palmemordet och Christer Pettersson
overview: Marks the 30th anniversary of the assassination of Prime Minister Olof Palme. Leif GW Persson discusses the lead that has dominated the investigation more than any other: Christer Pettersson. Leif has also received a tip regarding new bullets, and this time he decides to conduct his own investigation.
